newsitem.title: FRANCE: GAN to sell Belgian unit to Swiss Life.
newsitem.headline: GAN to sell Belgian unit to Swiss Life.

text.p: French insurer GAN said on Friday that it signed an agreement to sell its GAN Belgium unit to Swiss Life's Swiss Life Belgium for 3.5 billion Belgian francs ($112.7 million), or 575 million French francs. ($ = 31.05 Belgian Francs)
GAN to sell Belgian unit to Swiss =2
GAN said the sale fitted with its restructuring plan.

It said Swiss Life Belgium bought its Belgian unit due to synergies and that the purchase represented a significant expansion. The move also reinforces Swiss Life's position as one of the ten largest life insurers in Belgium, GAN said.
The conclusion of the deal depends on regulatory approval in France and Belgium, GAN said.
